readout.summary: All four sources expect Columbia (5-1) to beat winless Saint Peter's (0-6) at home. Dimers' model gives Columbia a 91.9% chance (-1450) and projects 73-59, though its value bet is Over 125.5. Bang The Book takes Columbia on the moneyline, citing its shooting (47%, 83.0 points a game) against a Saint Peter's offense scoring 48.8 on 31% shooting; Doc's Sports also takes Columbia. Columbia beat Boston 80-71 last time out; Saint Peter's lost 67-52 at Stony Brook, shooting 4 of 19 from three. The contrarian note: Scores24 picks Columbia to win but bets Saint Peter's +15.5, as the Peacocks covered that number in 14 of their last 16 road games. No injuries reported.

picks.note: Stronger shooting and passing; Saint Peter's scores 48.8 a game

Both teams are 2-4; Marshall has lost to Ohio State, Toledo, Youngstown State and North Carolina, and Prairie View has lost four straight. The two computer previews (iHeart and Bleacher Nation, same data provider) project Marshall 80-69, an 11-point win short of the 15.5 spread, and iHeart takes Prairie View +15.5 and the Under 151.5. Prairie View allows 82.7 points (331st) and 48.4% shooting (338th), but Marshall shoots only 42.7% (282nd). Covers trends: Prairie View covered in 14 of its last 16 road games, Marshall in 5 of its last 18 at home. Noah Otshudi (20.2) leads Marshall; Michael Eley (16.5) leads Prairie View. readout.summary: Five of six sources back unbeaten USC (6-0) over unbeaten South Carolina (5-0) at Acrisure Arena in Palm Desert, a neutral site. Bang The Book takes USC on the moneyline, Pick Dawgz and iHeart take USC against the spread, and the CappersPicks AI model projects USC by 22 (88-66); iHeart and Bleacher Nation both project USC 81-66. The case: USC scores 94.2 a game on 52% shooting and ranks 9th in defensive eFG%, while South Carolina has yet to play away from home. Alijah Arenas (21.3) leads USC; Juan Fernandez (15.2) leads South Carolina. Doc's Sports is the lone dissent, taking South Carolina without a line or reason. USC center Eric Reibe has been out all season (foot, offseason surgery; ClutchPoints Nov 19), so it is not new.

picks.note: Higher scoring and assist averages; already won away from home
